rationale: Ahmad's deep expertise in AI-native hardware form factors and spatial computing (Vision Pro, Leap Motion) complements Kaarel's ML foundation and track record of shipping fast—together they could prototype novel hardware-AI integration beyond traditional wearables. Ahmad is explicitly betting that AI hardware must be deeply integrated with generative models rather than bolt-on, while Kaarel's hackathon velocity and matching-problem ML work could accelerate that vision into a working system.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Kaarel Kaarelson — Ahmad leads hardware for Midjourney's next-gen AI devices and Kaarel is a founding ML engineer at a consumer AI startup; you both believe in shipping integrated AI experiences rather than incremental products, and your skills (hardware systems + ML velocity) could unlock a quick prototype.
